description: Return the dated appearance timeline of one party (from mRAG_graph_overview) — each source (email/message/call/…), its thread, the party's role, and when it occurred, newest first. Answers 'when and where did X show up'. Owner-scoped.

limit.description: Max timeline entries (newest first). Clamped to 200. Default 50.

party_id.description: The party whose dated appearance timeline to return (a party_id from mRAG_graph_overview).

name: mRAG_graph_timeline
